examples.text: Seated on the soft carpet with their drinks, they listened to a recording of koto, Japanese thirteen-string harp.

raw_glosses: (music) A Japanese stringed instrument having numerous strings, usually seven or thirteen, that are stretched over a convex wooden sounding board and are plucked with three plectra, worn on the thumb, index finger, and middle finger of one hand.
